question: Where can I get renewable curtailment and redispatch volumes in the United States, by zone or node and by period?

answer.summary: Only CAISO publishes a full series. Its daily renewable report gives curtailed wind and solar MWh by hour, five minutes, day and month, by type and local/system reason; a monthly CSV runs May 2014 to October 2026 (2024: 3,423,376; 2025: 3,766,065) and reconciles with the five-minute file and EIA. CAISO states exceptional-dispatch volume monthly (Sep 2026: 64,296 MWh), the nearest redispatch analogue. MISO shows daily average curtailment in MW only as PDF chart labels; ERCOT's market monitor gives annual percentages. No zone or node values were found; ERCOT's SCED disclosure was blocked.
main_caveats: Coverage is uneven: CAISO has MWh series; MISO only daily average MW in PDF charts; ERCOT only annual percentages (market monitor); other operators not opened.
Definitions differ: legacy CAISO PDFs measure against forecast, the market report against the dispatch upper limit; ERCOT's figures cover congestion curtailment.
CAISO's exceptional dispatch is manual out-of-market dispatch, not market redispatch; no other operator's redispatch volume was checked.
No zone or node values: CAISO local/system reason, MISO and ERCOT are system-wide; ERCOT's SCED disclosure blocked scripted access (403).
CAISO's PDF reports and five-minute workbook ended 2025-06-01; the daily HTML report holds its data as chart scripts, not a file; 'Operator Instruction' is undefined there.
The monthly CSV has no unit; MWh is inferred from EIA's 2024 figure and the five-minute file.
answer.confidence_reason: CAISO series were downloaded and reconciled (monthly CSV, five-minute file, EIA). MISO and ERCOT rest on one report each; other operators and ERCOT node data were not verified.

attributes.note: CAISO gives MWh with definitions; MISO daily average MW (PDF charts); ERCOT annual percentages (monitor).
attributes.gap_note: Only CAISO has MWh series with definitions; SPP, PJM, NYISO and ISO-NE pages were not opened and ERCOT's SCED disclosure returned 403. Definitions differ (forecast-based vs dispatch-limit-based; congestion only at ERCOT).

attributes.note: CAISO exceptional-dispatch MWh per month (Sep 2026: 64,296), incremental/decremental in figures.
attributes.gap_note: Exceptional dispatch is manual out-of-market dispatch, not market redispatch; no volume series was checked at ERCOT, MISO, SPP, PJM or NYISO and CAISO's direction split exists only as images.

attributes.note: Only system level with Local/System reason (CAISO), MISO-wide MW and ERCOT-wide percentages; no zone or node volumes found.
attributes.gap_note: CAISO and MISO publish no zone or node values in the files read; ERCOT's resource-level SCED disclosure (60-day delay) was blocked (403) and other operators were not opened.

attributes.note: CAISO: five-minute, hourly, daily and monthly periods with explicit dates; publication posted about 10:00 AM next day.
Daily report for Nov 18, 2026 (posted 11/19); monthly CSV through Oct 2026; market report through Sep 2026.
Monthly CSV May 2014-Oct 2026 (150 months, no gaps); five-minute 2025; daily PDFs to May 2025; definitions and labels changed over time.
Daily reports (observed ~10:00 AM next day, 18 consecutive in Nov 2026); monthly market report; legacy PDFs said 'produced daily'.

sources.name: Daily Renewable Report (curtailment of variable energy resources, CAISO)
sources.format: HTML report page with Highcharts charts; the values sit in embedded JavaScript arrays (curt_hourly_*, curt_five_min_*, curt_daily_*, curt_monthly_ytd_*)
sources.summary: CAISO's daily renewable report gives curtailed wind and solar energy (MWh) by hour, five minutes, day and month, split by type (economic, self-schedule cut, operator instruction) and reason (local, system).
sources.coverage_note: CAISO system level, no zone or node; latest listed report Nov 18, 2026 (posted the next morning).
caveats: Values are embedded in HTML chart scripts, not a data file.
Operator Instruction is not defined on the report (legacy label: ExDispatch).

problems: No machine-readable data file or API: values extracted from embedded script arrays.
Only the Nov 18, 2026 report was parsed (monthly YTD arrays reconcile with the monthly CSV: Jan-Oct 2026 5,297,888 MWh plus Nov 1-18 about 126,194 MWh against 5,424,087 MWh).

example.example_request: curl -L -A 'client/1.0' -o r.html https://www.caiso.com/documents/daily-renewable-report-nov-18-2026.html  # then read the JavaScript arrays curt_hourly_econ_local, curt_daily_econ_local_mwh, curt_monthly_ytd_econ_local_mwh ... from the largest <script> block
example.example_result: Report day 2026-11-18: hourly curtailment 2,016.6 MWh (Economic-Local 1,989.6, Economic-System 26.9, Self Schedule Cut-Local 0.1); last 15 days 94,497.7 MWh; year-to-date Jan-Nov 18, 2026 about 5,424,087 MWh by type.

sources.name: CAISO monthly wind and solar curtailment series (curtailments-monthly.csv)
sources.format: CSV (Date, Wind and solar curtailment, with a date-like header in the third column)
sources.summary: A 150-row monthly CSV of CAISO wind and solar curtailment from May 2014 to October 2026 (2024: 3,423,376; 2025: 3,766,065 per the file; unit inferred as MWh).
sources.coverage_note: System level, monthly; no type, reason or zone breakdown.
caveats: Unit is not stated in the file.

problems: Unit and definition not published in the file; EIA's Today in Energy (May 28, 2025) reports 3.4 million MWh of CAISO wind and solar curtailment in 2024 and a 29% increase, matching the 2024 and 2023 sums here.

sources.name: CAISO Market Performance Report (Section 10 Market Manual Adjustment: exceptional dispatch; Section 11 Renewable Resource)
sources.publisher: California ISO (CAISO), Department of Market Monitoring and Market Analysis
sources.format: HTML report (one page per section per month) with PNG figures
sources.summary: CAISO's monthly Market Performance Report states exceptional-dispatch volume in MWh (Sep 2026: 64,296) with incremental/decremental and reason figures, and defines how renewable curtailment is measured.
sources.coverage_note: System level, monthly, latest September 2026; reports reachable back to at least January 2023.
caveats: Exceptional dispatch is not the same as market redispatch.
Daily and directional splits are only in images.

problems: Only text and one PNG (Sep 2026 figure by reason) were read; figure 10.2 values (incremental/decremental) were not read.

example.example_request: curl -L -A 'client/1.0' https://www.caiso.com/content/monthly-market-performance/sep-2026/market-manual-adjustment.html  # read the sentence 'The total volume of exceptional dispatch ...'; figures at Monthly_Report_files/figure-html/mma-ed*-1.png
example.example_result: Exceptional dispatch volume: Jan 2026 156,062 MWh; Feb 2026 136,833; Aug 2026 45,706; Sep 2026 64,296. Feb 2026 shares: planned transmission outage 51.4%, unit testing 21.2%, voltage support 26.4%.

sources.name: MISO Monthly Operations Report (Daily Wind and Solar Energy and Curtailment)
sources.publisher: Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO), Market and Operations Analytics
sources.format: PDF (60 pages; charts with printed values, no tables)
sources.summary: MISO's monthly operations report charts daily average wind and solar curtailment in MW for the whole system; September 2025 wind curtailment peaked at 1,281 MW on 09/08.
sources.coverage_note: System level, daily average MW, one issue opened (September 2025).
caveats: Chart labels only; no table or machine-readable file.
MW average, not MWh; no node or zone.

problems: Only the September 2025 issue was opened; the text layer contains no curtailment numbers (values read from rendered pages).

example.example_request: curl -L -o miso_sep2025.pdf 'https://cdn.misoenergy.org/202509%20Market%20and%20Operation%20Report723860.pdf'  # pages 39 and 43; the text layer has no values, render pages to images
example.example_result: Sep 2025 daily average wind curtailment: 1,210 MW on 09/04 and 1,281 MW on 09/08; solar curtailment peaked at 204 MW on 09/05.

sources.name: 2025 State of the Market Report for the ERCOT Electricity Markets (wind and solar curtailment)
sources.publisher: Potomac Economics, Independent Market Monitor for ERCOT
sources.summary: ERCOT's independent market monitor reports that about 4.7% of wind and about 6% of solar generation was curtailed (congestion) in ERCOT in 2025.
sources.coverage_note: Annual percentages for ERCOT as a whole; no MWh table, node or zone values in the text.
caveats: Percentages only; chart values not extracted.
Published by the market monitor, not by ERCOT.

problems: Chart values are not machine-readable; only percentages in the text were read.

example.example_request: curl -L -o ercot_som_2025.pdf https://www.potomaceconomics.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/2025-State-of-the-Market-Report-for-ERCOT.pdf  # section D 'Wind and Solar Generation in ERCOT'
example.example_result: Roughly 4.7% of wind generation and roughly 6% of solar generation were curtailed in ERCOT in 2025.

if_unstructured.summary: MISO and CAISO market reports are PDF or HTML documents with chart values; no data tables are provided for MISO or for CAISO's exceptional-dispatch daily splits.

local_terms.meaning: CAISO operator instruction outside the market solution, used for non-modeled constraints and reliability; the closest published analogue of redispatch.
CAISO reasons: local congestion versus system-wide oversupply.
ERCOT security-constrained economic dispatch, source of base points and limits.
